annotation_description: Clarion Conqueror is a Dragon spell, so it could have been cast using the second ability of Maelstrom of the Spirit Dragon which produces colored mana (any color) restricted to Dragon/Omen spells. By using ability 1 ({T}: Add {C}) instead of ability 2 ({T}: Add one mana of any color for Dragon spells), the player gets colorless mana instead of colored mana. Since Clarion Conqueror costs {2}{W}, the colorless mana works fine for the generic portion, but using the Dragon-restricted colored mana ability would have been functionally equivalent here - the {W} is presumably coming from another source. However, by using ability 2 to produce {W}, the player could have potentially freed up one of their white sources (Sacred Foundry or Inspiring Vantage) to produce mana for other spells this turn, like casting Momo ({W}) in addition to Clarion Conqueror. With ability 2 producing {W} for Dragon spell, plus Sacred Foundry for {W}, plus untapped Inspiring Vantage for {R} or {W}, the player would have had enough mana to cast both Clarion Conqueror ({2}{W}) and Momo ({W}) after playing Sunbillow Verge. Using ability 1 for {C} instead means they likely can't cast both.
